question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
-- Pivoting entertainer styles to get first and second strongest styles
WITH ent_styles AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID, StyleStrength,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EntertainerID ORDER BY StyleStrength DESC) as rank
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
),
ent_first_second AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_style,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_style
    FROM ent_styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
-- Pivoting customer preferences
cust_prefs AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID, PreferenceSeq,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerID ORDER BY PreferenceSeq) as rank
    FROM Musical_Preferences
),
cust_first_second AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN StyleID END) as first_pref,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN StyleID END) as second_pref
    FROM cust_prefs
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)
SELECT 
    e.EntStageName,
    c.CustLastName
FROM ent_first_second ef
JOIN cust_first_second cf ON 1=1
JOIN Entertainers e ON e.EntertainerID = ef.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = cf.CustomerID
WHERE 
    (ef.first_style = cf.first_pref AND ef.second_style = cf.second_pref)
    OR 
    (ef.first_style = cf.second_pref AND ef.second_style = cf.first_pref)
